description: Brick-walled foundry yard cluttered with a furnace, crucibles and stacked moulds under a low smoke ceiling: the clutter breaks up the reflections, so the tail is shorter and drier than the courtyard's, with a little metallic flutter (predelay feedback) off the iron. The high-pass keeps the furnace and wheel rumble out of the tail. Measured on a sword hit with tools/audio/arena.py: tail energy 11.1 dB under the dry hit (courtyard 8.3), decay 1.1 s (courtyard 1.3 s).
